summary.text: Will Hurley is a Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Strafford 12, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A filmmaker raised in Rollinsford, Hurley said in a Ballotpedia survey that his priorities are public schools, affordable housing, local small businesses and representing the whole community.

paragraphs.text: Will Hurley graduated from Somersworth High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Ithaca College in 2014.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as filmmaker, and in a Ballotpedia survey Hurley said he works in video production.
He said he was raised in Rollinsford, attended Somersworth Middle and High School, and is raising two children with his wife in the community, where he said his family has lived for nine generations.
Hurley said he opposes Education Freedom Accounts, arguing that public funds belong in public schools.
